scripts.text: [Guillaume Mercenary Officer]
It seems you have recently participated in a KVM battle. You must wait 5 minutes before signing up again.
scripts.translation: 你最近似乎参加过KVM战斗。必须等待5分钟才能再次报名。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Mercenary Officer]
Let them know the real might of Guillaume!
scripts.translation: 让他们见识吉约姆真正的实力！

scripts.text: I will fight with you.
End Conversation.
[Guillaume Mercenary Officer]
Show them how strong we are.
scripts.translation: 让他们看看我们有多强。

scripts.text: Today, everyone will hear the shout of triumph from Guillaume!
scripts.translation: 今天，所有人都会听到吉约姆胜利的欢呼！

scripts.text: [Guillaume Mercenary Officer]
We will win!
[Guillaume Knight]
Hello.
What do you want to know?
Apply for KVM.
What is KVM?
How do I participate in KVM?
I want to know my Kreiger Points.
scripts.translation: 我想查看自己的克里格点数。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
If you are ready for battle, click the ^0000FFbattle button from the interface^000000 to apply for KVM battle!
scripts.translation: 准备好战斗的话，请点击界面上的^0000FF战斗按钮^000000报名参加KVM战斗！

scripts.text: Applications are not available yet.
To apply, you need to go to a KVM Mercenary Officer.
scripts.translation: 报名需要前往KVM佣兵队长处。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
KVM is the abbreviation of Kreiger Von Midgard.
scripts.translation: KVM是Kreiger Von Midgard（米德加尔特骑士团）的缩写。

scripts.text: Adventurer, are you aware that the way to the new world has been opened?
scripts.translation: 冒险者，你知道通往新世界的道路已经开放了吗？

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
We, the Guillaume Administration, have several plans to advance to the new world.
scripts.translation: 我们吉约姆行政机构制定了几项前往新世界的计划。

scripts.text: And KVM is one of them.
[Guillaume Knight]
It means that we, one of many countries in the Midgard continent,
scripts.translation: 也就是说，我们米德加尔特大陆的众多国家之一，

scripts.text: have decided to employ many adventurers for the immediate advance to the new world.
scripts.translation: 决定招募大量冒险者，立即前往新世界。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
Therefore, to select the best adventurers, we are holding the KVM.
scripts.translation: 因此，为了选出最优秀的冒险者，我们举办了KVM。

scripts.text: We exspect responses from many adventurers.
scripts.translation: 我们期待许多冒险者报名参加。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
And we will give them rewards for their participation!
scripts.translation: 我们还会奖励所有参与者！

scripts.text: As for the rewards, please contact a KVM Logistic Officer.
scripts.translation: 奖励详情请咨询KVM后勤官。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
Basically, KVM is a 3 on 3 battle.
Apply by clicking on the ^0000FFbattle button from the interface^000000, as a group or individually.
scripts.translation: 点击界面上的^0000FF战斗按钮^000000报名，可以组队报名，也可以个人报名。

scripts.text: Basically, KVM is a 5 on 5 battle.
First, you apply with a KVM receptionist, in a group or individually.
scripts.translation: 首先，向KVM接待员报名，可以组队报名，也可以个人报名。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
Group applications are for when you intend to enter the KVM with your party or guild members,
scripts.translation: 如果想和队伍或公会成员一起进入KVM，就选择组队报名，

scripts.text: Group applications are for when you intend to enter the KVM with your party members,
scripts.translation: 如果想和队伍成员一起进入KVM，就选择组队报名，

scripts.text: and a personal application is for when you intend to enter the KVM individually.
scripts.translation: 个人报名则适用于独自进入KVM的情况。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
Please be noted, once you cancel you ^0000FFcannot apply again for 1 minute^000000.
scripts.translation: 请注意，取消报名后，^0000FF1分钟内不能再次报名^000000。

scripts.text: Please apply with a KVM officer, and he will contact you later when you are in Prontera.
scripts.translation: 请向KVM工作人员报名；你抵达普隆德拉后，他会联系你。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
Then you enter and follow the instructions in the battlefield.
scripts.translation: 进入战场后，按照指示行动即可。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
However, please be advised that unless you are in the KVM office, he cannot contact you.
scripts.translation: 请注意，除非你在KVM办公室，否则他无法联系你。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
Your Kreiger Points are:
